The '''Towers of Pantolomin''' was a profitable resort on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. It was owned by a subsidiary of [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', 24.</ref>
